title: Damage Dummy
description: Ever wanted a way to check your damage?
body:
# Description
damage dummy is a simple datapack which makes it that you can see your damage. the bot will output the damage amount around itself, like this:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1f37973f9031ed52a78348357969346bf301a3c.png)

and you can also modify the bot, like it's armor what other specific things, menu preview:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/88753009e86c13650f563f4dedfd9d9f8351431b.png)
but for one of the tabs, you can actually modify further, knockback tab prview:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1e107bb01c26c092496e80284aed2cba2b8eab3.png)

## Summon
you can summon the bot with this command:

```
/function damage_dummy:technical/summon
```

you can modify the bot or open the menu with this command:

```
/function damage_dummy:technical/menu
```

if you were wondering how can you tell which bot you are modifying, well the target will get glowing so you can easily identify which one you are modifying, here is a preview:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf8a29ffb8252c4bfb819836761858827cf4b3d3.png)
in the background of opening the menu, you can see the subtle outline from the glowing effect.
